TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cetr.]
Very bitter and slimy taste.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cetr.]
Increased the appetite (if not boiled too long).
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Cetr.]
Feels full and satisfied after eating a little. θ Phthisis. *
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cetr.]
Strengthens digestive power and is very nutritive.
Constricted feeling above scrobiculum, and distension ; also felt in back. θ Phthisis. *
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cetr.]
Rarely diarrhœa.
After using it, the first formed stool and not offensive. θ Diarrhœa of consumptive. *
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Cetr.]
It makes the milk of the nursing bitter.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Cetr.]
Tickling and spasmodic feeling in windpipe, on waking. θ Phthisis. *
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cetr.]
Shortness of breath, weakness, has to stop to get breath when walking out-doors. θ Phthisis. *
Rales. θ Phthisis. *
   

COUGH. [27] [Cetr.]
Violent cough, beginning at breakfast and lasting several hours, with copious expectoration. θ Phthisis. *
Violent spells of coughing during the day, none at night. θ Phthisis. *
Copious, thick, yellow, lumpy expectoration. θ Phthisis. *
Expectoration has a rotten taste and smell, which nauseates her. θ Phthisis. *
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cetr.]
Consumptives. *
Pain in chest.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Cetr.]
Oppression of chest, particularly with morning cough. θ Phthisis. *
   

FEVER. [40] [Cetr.]
Chill in forenoon, fever in afternoon. θ Phthisis. *
Sweat towards morning, with weakness. θ Phthisis. *
